connector.none: no captured connector fetches web pages

reads.note: HTTP Request v4.2 GET of the submitted URL; response format autodetect: text/html becomes $json.data as a string

expect.offline: Only the landing page is outside data; the agent's answer is the stand-in model's (o1 with reasoningEffort high in the template). The form answers on submission (responseMode onReceived), so no reply carries the roast: the only compared output is the agent's model input
